request: I have a design I need to print. I need flat pedals that I can clip to my SPD clipless mountain bike pedals (like a conversion kit). This design would allow me to bolt on the standard shimano cleats and act as pedals with grips for my shoes. The pedals are Shimano PD-M520-type two-sided SPD pedals and the cleat is the standard Shimano SM-SH51 two-bolt SPD cleat, fastened with M5 bolts and nuts. The cleat position has to be adjustable fore-aft like on a shoe. The platform should be about the size of an ordinary flat pedal (between 80 and 105 mm each way). It is printed on an FDM printer in PETG with no supports, and one printed adapter (or a left/right pair) goes on each pedal. Requirements: The design shall carry one Shimano SM-SH51 cleat (catalogue cleat) with its mount face against the adapter's cleat seat, fastened by the cleat's own two bolt positions with standard M5 hardware (catalogue M5 socket-head bolts and M5 hex nuts), and shall declare the layout (cleat pose, bolts, nuts, grip features, print orientation). The cleat shall be adjustable fore-aft by at least 20 mm and sideways by at least 5 mm, as on a shoe, and shall clamp firmly at any position in that range; each nut shall be held captive so that it does not turn when a bolt is tightened with a 4 mm hex key. At every cleat position in that range the M5 hardware shall fit: each bolt head shall seat on the cleat and be reachable with a 4 mm hex key from the pedal side with the adapter off the pedal, each bolt shall engage its nut for its whole thickness, and no bolt tip shall reach the top face of the platform. The adapter shall let the cleat clip into the SPD pedal: with the adapter on the pedal in the engaged pose, nothing but the cleat shall enter the pedal's binding space or the cleat's recess space, at every cleat position in the adjustment range. The adapter's pedal-side face shall sit on the pedal's sole plane like a shoe sole: no adapter material below that plane outside the cleat, and a flat bearing area of at least 600 mm2 on it. The adapter shall clear the crank arm: with the cleat at any position in its sideways range, and the adapter twisted about the cleat axis through the release angle either way, every point of the adapter shall stay at least 2.0 mm from the crank arm's inner face. The platform shall be sized like a commercial flat pedal: each plan dimension between 80 and 105 mm, with a thickness above the pedal-side face of 8 to 14 mm, not counting the grip features. The top face shall carry grip features for shoes: at least 8 raised pins or ridges, each 1.5 to 5.0 mm tall, spread over at least 60 percent of the platform's plan area and kept at least 3 mm from its edge. The adapter shall carry a standing rider: a 2500 N load on a 30 x 30 mm patch at the outer edge of the platform, with only the cleat clamp footprint as support, shall give a bending stress at most 1/1.5 of the printed material's 25 MPa in-plane strength. One printed part shall serve both pedals: the part and its mirror image shall both pass every check above (or the design shall declare a left/right pair of two mirror-image parts, each passing every check on its own pedal). Each printed body shall be one manifold body that prints in PETG on an FDM printer without supports in its declared orientation, with no feature thinner than 0.8 mm, and fit a 200 x 200 x 200 mm bed. The design shall be delivered as the STL of each printed body, the OpenSCAD source, the declared layout and the agent's own clearance and strength report, and that report shall agree with an independent measurement.
